sub_graphs.title: EIP-6110: Validator Deposit On-Chain Processing
sub_graphs.description: Models the lifecycle of validator deposits from on-chain submission to consensus layer inclusion

nodes.label: Deposit Transaction Submitted
nodes.description: A transaction calling the deposit contract has been submitted to the execution layer

nodes.label: Execute Deposit Transaction
nodes.description: EVM executes the deposit contract call, emitting DepositEvent log

nodes.label: Deposit Event Emitted
nodes.description: DepositEvent log has been emitted with pubkey, withdrawal_credentials, amount, signature, index

nodes.label: Parse Deposit Logs from Receipts
nodes.description: Block producer filters transaction receipts for deposit contract logs matching DEPOSIT_EVENT_SIGNATURE_HASH

nodes.label: Deposit Requests Extracted
nodes.description: All valid deposit requests have been extracted from block receipts

nodes.label: Append Deposits to Block
nodes.description: Include deposit_requests in the ExecutionRequests field via EIP-7685

nodes.label: Block Contains Deposit Requests
nodes.description: Execution layer block now contains deposit_requests field populated from logs

nodes.label: Consensus Layer Processes Deposits
nodes.description: Beacon chain processes deposits from execution payload, updating validator registry

nodes.label: Validator Deposit Applied
nodes.description: Validator deposit has been processed into BeaconState

edges.label: Staker submits deposit transaction to execution layer
Transaction included in block and executed

sub_graphs.title: EIP-6110: Deposit Log Validation
sub_graphs.description: Models the validation rules for deposit event parsing and block validity

nodes.label: Log Entry Received from Receipt
nodes.description: A log entry has been read from transaction receipt

nodes.label: Validate Deposit Contract Address
nodes.description: Check log address equals DEPOSIT_CONTRACT_ADDRESS (0x00000000219ab540356cbb839cbe05303d7705fa)

nodes.label: Contract Address Valid
nodes.description: Log originated from the official deposit contract

nodes.label: Contract Address Invalid
nodes.description: Log not from deposit contract - skip this log

nodes.label: Validate Event Signature Hash
nodes.description: Check first topic equals DEPOSIT_EVENT_SIGNATURE_HASH (0x649bbc62d0e31342afea4e5cd82d4049e7e1ee912fc0889aa790803be39038c5)

nodes.label: Event Signature Valid
nodes.description: Log is a valid DepositEvent

nodes.label: Event Signature Invalid
nodes.description: Log topic does not match DepositEvent - skip

nodes.label: Validate Deposit Data Length
nodes.description: Check deposit event data is exactly 576 bytes

nodes.label: Data Length Valid (576 bytes)
nodes.description: Deposit data has correct length for parsing

nodes.label: Parse Deposit Fields
nodes.description: Extract pubkey(48), withdrawal_credentials(32), amount(8), signature(96), index(8) from data

nodes.label: Deposit Request Parsed
nodes.description: Valid deposit request ready for inclusion

sub_graphs.title: EIP-6110: Eth1Data Deprecation Transition
sub_graphs.description: Models the state transition from legacy Eth1Data polling to on-chain deposit mechanism

nodes.label: Legacy Eth1Data Polling Active
nodes.description: Consensus layer still uses Eth1Data voting for deposit root

nodes.label: Check Deposit Index Alignment
nodes.description: Compare eth1_deposit_index with deposit_requests_start_index

nodes.label: Transition Pending
nodes.description: eth1_deposit_index < deposit_requests_start_index, legacy mechanism still needed

nodes.label: Transition Complete
nodes.description: eth1_deposit_index == deposit_requests_start_index, Eth1Data polling can stop

nodes.label: Disable Eth1Data Polling
nodes.description: Consensus clients stop JSON-RPC polling for deposit data

nodes.label: On-Chain Deposits Only
nodes.description: All deposits now sourced from execution layer block structure

sub_graphs.title: EIP-6110: DoS Attack Surface Analysis
sub_graphs.description: Models the security boundaries and DoS vectors for on-chain deposits

nodes.label: Attacker Submits Many Deposits
nodes.description: Malicious actor submitting maximum deposits per block

nodes.label: Calculate Attack Cost
nodes.description: Minimum deposit cost ~5.2M Gwei per byte, orders of magnitude higher than calldata

nodes.label: Attack Economically Infeasible
nodes.description: Cost to slow block processing by 1 second requires ~1000 ETH

nodes.label: Node in Optimistic Sync
nodes.description: Node accepting blocks without full validation

nodes.label: Receive Maximum Deposits (8192)
nodes.description: Process up to 8192 deposits in single payload (~1.5MB)

nodes.label: Block Processing Delayed
nodes.description: Up to ~8 seconds processing delay for signature verification

nodes.label: Verify BLS Signatures
nodes.description: Verify all deposit signatures (~1.2 seconds for 1271 deposits at 30M gas)

nodes.label: All Signatures Verified
nodes.description: Deposits validated and ready for processing

edges.label: Attack not viable due to cost

external_entities.name: DoS Attacker
external_entities.description: Malicious actor attempting to slow down block processing via deposit spam

ambiguities.text: The transition from Eth1Data polling to on-chain deposits requires 'eth1_deposit_index == deposit_requests_start_index' but the exact timing and mechanism for setting deposit_requests_start_index is not fully specified.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume deposit_requests_start_index is set at fork activation to the current eth1_deposit_index value, creating immediate alignment possibility.

ambiguities.text: The behavior when a deposit contract log has exactly 576 bytes but contains malformed field data (e.g., invalid pubkey format) is not explicitly defined.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume field parsing is purely structural (extract bytes at offsets) with no additional format validation at the execution layer; consensus layer validates cryptographic correctness.

implicit_assumptions.description: The deposit contract at DEPOSIT_CONTRACT_ADDRESS is immutable and correctly implements the DepositEvent emission logic.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If the deposit contract could be modified or contains bugs, invalid deposits could be injected into the validator registry.

implicit_assumptions.description: Execution layer clients can efficiently process and filter logs from transaction receipts without significant performance degradation.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Block processing time could increase significantly, potentially causing missed slots or chain splits.

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot economically sustain deposit spam attacks due to the high cost per deposit (15,650+ gas).
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Sustained deposit spam could degrade network performance and increase validator processing overhead.
